name: Exgentic
description: Exgentic is a practical framework for evaluating general-purpose agents across diverse environments without domain-specific tuning. It enables systematic benchmarking of agents' generalization capabilities and supports a unified protocol for agent-benchmark integration, establishing the first Open General Agent Leaderboard.
reputation: A new benchmark and leaderboard for general-purpose agents that is still early in adoption compared with established agent evaluation suites.
notes: Includes a unified evaluation protocol, framework, and leaderboard for general agent evaluation across multiple environments.
